note: From docs, developer reports and device tests.

platforms.note: Autoplays the MP4 muted, looping. With autoplay off or Reduce Motion: poster with a play button. Apple's guideline: icon, image and video under 10 MB together. Device-tested 24 Oct 2026.

Inline player with a play button; does not autoplay. Device-tested 24 Oct 2026 on the Mac and iOS clients with a plain og:type website page and a direct MP4. Discord's docs only describe og:type video.* or twitter:card player; neither was needed.
Shows og:image. Tested 24 Oct; FxEmbed's claim that it plays did not hold.
Link cards show og:image. The viral og:video posts were iMessage screen recordings.
Uses og:image as the thumbnail; og:video not mentioned.
Classic unfurls read Open Graph and Twitter Card tags and show og:image; video players only for sites Slack handles itself, or through an app unfurl.
Link cards carry a title, description and one thumbnail (app.bsky.embed.external); there is no video field.
Video cards come from oEmbed, not og:video.
Shows og:image with the title and description; no video.
Reads og:image, title, description; no video seen.
Element shows the title, description and og:image that the homeserver's URL preview endpoint returns; no og:video support.
Shows og:image. Tested 24 Oct; docs say an MP4 is only 'eligible' for inline play.
